description: "What annotation tracks does UCSC have for hg38" / "does [assembly] have a [ClinVar/GENCODE/conservation/repeat] track" / "what is the track name for [dataset] in the genome browser" — lists the annotation tracks available on one UCSC assembly, with each track's internal name, short and long label, data type and parent container. AUTHORITATIVE for the `track` argument of ucsc_track_data: the browser shows human-readable labels, the API wants the internal name (e.g. label "GENCODE V50" is track `knownGene`), and there is no way to guess one from the other.

genome.description: REQUIRED. UCSC assembly ID — the genome build your coordinates are in. Human: "hg38" (= GRCh38, current) or "hg19" (= GRCh37, what most older papers, dbSNP dumps and clinical spreadsheets use). Mouse: "mm39"/"mm10". These are DIFFERENT coordinate systems: the same chrom/start/end is valid in every build, so a wrong build returns confident annotations for a different gene instead of an error. Call ucsc_genomes to list the assembly IDs for a species.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over track name, short label and long label. e.g. "clinvar", "gencode", "conservation".
